name: article-series-outline
title: Series outline
description: Where you are in a multi-part series: every part in order, with Read, You are here and Soon told in words, as a card or a strip.
docs: Pass the series (a title and an optional href) and the parts in order. current is the number of the page you are on, counted from 1; leave it out on the series' own page. A part before it is Read, the current one is You are here and carries aria-current, and a part after it is plain text marked Soon, with its releaseDate when it has one, unless it has an href: then it is a published part and links. Set state on a part to override that, for a site that knows what each reader has read. layout is card (a sidebar, or the end of an article beside the pager) or strip (across the top of the body); both follow the width of their own column. Upcoming parts are never dead links. The outline is a navigation landmark named after the series; give two outlines on one page their own aria-label. Pass linkAs={Link} to route the links and labels to translate the words.
